text_block_list.text:
Due to her standing as part of the 
“Illustrious Family,” Daiichi Ruby's debut 
race was met with immense public 
attention.

The racing officials and insiders aren't 
the only ones pinning their hopes on her—

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so many flowers have arrived...! Are 
these all from the "Illustrious Clan"?

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff B
text_block_list.text:
That's right, two truckloads! Quit 
daydreaming and get moving!

An immense number of congratulatory 
flowers had arrived for Daiichi Ruby. 
Their sheer volume and elegance were 
overwhelming...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Let's head to the waiting room.

Yet she didn't spare them a glance, 
heading briskly into the racetrack. And 
what's more—

text_block_list.name: Council Member A
text_block_list.text:
“—Let us give a round of applause to 
celebrate Miss Daiichi Ruby's glorious new 
beginning!!”
(Clap clap clap...!)

The unexpected visitor was an 
up-and-coming politician. Accompanied by 
an entourage, they walked in without an 
appointment.

text_block_list.name: Council Member A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what an honor! To be present for the 
debut of a young lady from the illustrious 
"Sublime Clan"!
choice_data_list:
(Even though she just barged in on her 
own...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the 
congratulations.

Daiichi Ruby handled the situation with 
practiced ease. It was right before an 
important debut race; ordinarily, we'd 
want them to leave immediately, but...
choice_data_list: (They might be someone she's close to...)

text_block_list.name: Council Member A
text_block_list.text:
I brought some celebratory flowers and a 
little gift as well. I do hope you like 
them!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Your thought is more than enough, so 
please keep it for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Council Member A
text_block_list.text: Huh? But—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon the interruption, Milady. I 
believe it is almost time to get ready.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Pardon us, but our time is up. Thank you 
so much for all your support.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, please inform us in advance, 
and do come in through the front 
entrance."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you possess the pride and confidence 
worthy of my family's esteem, that is.

text_block_list.name: Council Member A
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, pardon my intrusion. So sorry 
to have bothered you!"

text_block_list.name: Council Member A
text_block_list.text:
Please give my regards to your family as 
well! I look forward to seeing you in 
action!

Just as noisily as they had entered, they 
left. Breathing a sigh of relief—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Milady, I am deeply sorry. I had 
instructed all staff to turn away any and 
all visitors, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
She probably couldn't bring herself to 
refuse. It can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
True to the rumors, she certainly had an 
intimidating presence.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I thought you intended to use me to flaunt 
your connection to the family.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Since you've only recently made a name 
for yourself, you must be looking for a 
backer."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It is nothing to be surprised about.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"All of those flowers, too, carry the 
intentions of their senders."

Her gaze directed toward the beautiful 
celebratory flowers tailored just for 
her...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Those floral stands by the entrance... It 
appears that company is currently 
struggling with financing. No doubt they 
are seeking my family's assistance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Those flowers centered around the lilies 
were a gift from someone currently at the 
heart of government."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The intention behind the passionate 
enclosed letter is obvious. By ensnaring 
me, the descendant, they wish to solidify 
their influence far into the future—

Daiichi Ruby dispassionately introduced 
the flowers alongside their intended 
meanings. Now I finally understood why she 
hadn't shown any sign of emotion.
choice_data_list:
(There's an ulterior motive behind that, 
so...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...It's time. I shall head to the turf."

Her judgment is probably sound. But... it 
felt a little lonely. Amidst the swirling 
web of motives, there must be those who 
purely want to cheer her on, too.
choice_data_list:
(That flower should be nothing but 
beautiful, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Here it comes... Win or lose, this is 
gonna be one tasty treat...!"

text_block_list.name: Noble Person
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is the VIP room not this way? Could 
you guide me there, then?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, crazy... Were there always this 
many people at debut races?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Look, she's coming out! —The one from the 
"Illustrious Clan"!

—The cheers of the crowd can be heard. 
Most of them are waiting on the edge of 
their seats for the arrival of the 
"Illustrious Clan."

Despite the immense pressure she must be 
under, Daiichi Ruby remained completely 
unperturbed. Her absolute calm only 
sparked more anxiety, and without 
thinking—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are fully in order. Please 
let me know if you have any concerns.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Allow me to state this in advance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
While I am truly grateful for the 
expectations placed upon me, I have never 
once considered them a burden—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, absolutely not.

Daiichi Ruby paused her words and asserted 
firmly. There was unmistakably no 
hesitation in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall take my leave.

As she shouldered everything all on her 
own, those were the only words I could 
squeeze out.
